messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=rate-limiter svc-id=rl-prod code=429-spike - high 429 rate across multiple zones. Pager: @sre-oncall, @kevin.

pagerduty-bot: Incident #INC-362555 opened, urgency=high. Ack required.

sam: acked. I'm looking at the 429 graphs now — huge spike starting ~3625549900, correlates with a recent config push to quota-mapper. Lots of customers seeing generation timeouts.

taylor: I'm on first triage. quick check: kubectl logs -n inference rate-limiter-0 | grep quota-mapper | tail -n 50 shows repeated "missing-tenant-tag" warnings then immediate 429 emit. Pasting snippet:```
2026-03-12T09:25:01Z WARN quota-mapper: tenant_tag missing for token abc123
2026-03-12T09:25:01Z ERROR limiter: apply_quota failed -> enforce=true returned 429
```

dana: Confirming in metrics: token->tenant mapping failure rate up 98% for last 10m. Throughput steady but success rate collapsed. This smells like a mapping-table rotation bug.

kevin: Who deployed quota-mapper recently? I see a canary at 3625549800. @taylor can you roll that back or flip to safe-mode?

taylor: can do. I'm going to flip enforcement to soft-mode via runtime flag to stop customer-facing 429s while we investigate. Command: `rcu set /rate-limiter/enforce "soft" --env prod` (will apply across pool).

sam: please coordinate with product-ops before flipping, need to whitelist high-traffic tenants to avoid data loss. product-ops: any critical tenants to protect?

product-ops: Yes — enterprise-foo and partner-bar are showing elevated errors. Whitelist them if possible. Also notify customer success.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by sam at 3625550010. Escalation to eng-sre in 5m if not resolved.

sre-oncall: I'm joining. From initial look, the canary introduced a schema change for tag fallback that causes empty tenant tag for legacy tokens. Quick mitigation plan: (1) set enforcement=soft (2) add explicit tenant fallback mapping for legacy tokens (3) rollback canary if needed.

kevin: I'll push the fallback mapping to configstore now:```
PUT /configstore/rate-limiter/tenants/legacy -> {"fallback_tenant":"legacy-default"}
```

taylor: enforcement flag set to soft at 3625550065. 429 rate dropped by ~70% but still some residuals. 

sam: I can see customer-facing errors falling on dashboards, but one partner reported intermittent 503s — maybe downstream backlog. Are we throttling downstream model proxies?

dana: yes, downstream queues spiked when enforcement moved to soft because backlog drained now but some nodes are still rejecting. I'm draining non-critical traffic: toggling feature flags for experimental routing groups. Command: `ff-toggle --group=exp-samples --off`

pagerduty-bot: Route protection applied. Escalation cancelled.

kevin: rolled forward the legacy fallback mapping at 3625550090. Logs show tenant_tag resolved for tokens with prefix legacy-. Error rate further reduced.

taylor: I've prepared a rollback job for the canary but holding for 10 minutes to confirm stability. If we still see anomalies we'll spin rollback.

sam: Customer impact summary so far: ~18 tenants affected across generation endpoints, peak error rate ~22k/min 429s, degraded latency for 200+ API keys, no data loss reported, some partners experienced timeouts. Notifying CS and Account execs now.

product-ops: Noted. Sending templated incident update to affected customers with ETA for full fix.

kevin: quick root-cause hypothesis: the canary introduced a new tag normalization that doesn't handle legacy token format; when mapper returns null tenant we enforced quota and emitted 429 instead of falling back. Configs were rotated with zero-downtime but missing migration for legacy tokens.

sre-oncall: agreed. Next steps: (1) keep enforcement=soft until end of rolling rollback OR until mapper verifies mapping success rate >99.9% for 10m (2) schedule a controlled rollback of canary if mapping doesn't stabilize (3) postmortem and migration plan for tokens.

taylor: I'll coordinate rollback window. Tentatively plan rollback at 3625550300 if no full recovery.

sam: I'm creating a short incident thread for later postmortem. Recording mitigation commands and timeline.

kevin: after fallback mapping and soft enforcement, latency is back to normal for majority of tenants. We'll keep monitoring.

incident-bot: Incident #INC-362555 updated: mitigation applied (soft enforcement + legacy fallback); currently in steady-state.

dana: final notes: capture affected token examples and config diff:```
- old mapper: normalize_v1(token) -> tenant or fallback=legacy-default
- new mapper: normalize_v2(token) -> tenant or null  <-- missing fallback handling
```

sam: handing off to taylor for next-hour watch. taylor please escalate to eng-sre if mapping < 99% in next 30m.

taylor: taking watch. I'll post a follow-up in 30m with metrics.

product-ops: thanks team. We'll prepare customer comms and follow-up with CS.

sam: closing on-call handover. Preliminary RCA points: problematic canary + missing migration for legacy tokens -> misapplied quotas -> unexpected throttling. Postmortem required with rollout hardening checklist.

incident-bot: Incident #INC-362555 resolved for now at 3625550123 (status: monitoring).
